claim.claim-text: 1. A graphene reinforced polyethylene terephthalate composition, comprising:

a continuous matrix comprising polyethylene terephthalate; and graphene nanoplatelets in the form of one or more layers of two-dimensional mono-atomic carbon sheets dispersed within the continuous matrix, wherein the graphene reinforced polyethylene terephthalate composition comprises a concentration of graphene nanoplatelets ranging between 0.005% and 0.1% weight fraction of the graphene reinforced polyethylene terephthalate composition.

2. The graphene reinforced polyethylene terephthalate composition of claim 1, wherein the concentration of graphene nanoplatelets ranges between 0.005% and 0.01% weight fraction of the graphene reinforced polyethylene terephthalate composition.

3. The graphene reinforced polyethylene terephthalate composition of claim 1, wherein the concentration of graphene nanoplatelets ranges between 0.01% and 0.1% weight fraction of the graphene reinforced polyethylene terephthalate composition.
4. The graphene reinforced polyethylene terephthalate composition of claim 1, wherein the graphene nanoplatelets comprise an average surface area ranging between 15 m<2>/g and 750 m<2>/g.
5. The graphene reinforced polyethylene terephthalate composition of claim 4, wherein the graphene nanoplatelets comprise an average surface area ranging between 120 m<2>/g and 150 m<2>/g.
6. The graphene reinforced polyethylene terephthalate composition of claim 1, wherein the number of layers ranges between 1 and 7.
7. The graphene reinforced polyethylene terephthalate composition of claim 6, wherein the number of layers ranges between 1 and 4.
8. A method for preparing graphene reinforced polyethylene terephthalate (PET), the method comprising:
9. The method of claim 8, wherein sonicating is performed for a period of time ranging between 24 hours and 106 hours.
10. The method of claim 8, wherein centrifuging is performed at a centrifugal speed ranging between 1500 rpm and 4500 rpm.
11. The method of claim 8, wherein the solvent suitable for producing PET comprises ethylene glycol.
